mods.title: FNF': Rings Of Hell - Chains Of Deceit
mods.description: Welcome To Friday Night Funkin': Rings Of Hell!__________________________________________________After running a suspicious Sonic ROM hack, Boyfriend and Girlfriend are hit with a fatal error — suddenly finding themselves sucked directly into the game.Wandering through a distorted Green Hill Zone, they come face-to-face with Sonic... or at least, something that looks like him. mods.title: [BATCH 5] The Average OC Mod 2.5
mods.description: Less than a month since 2.0, Fah Mix arrives! Fah Mix will be a near yearly campaign of additions--with (likely) a song every two weeks! So buckle down, because a lot of drawing paper is gonna be used.The Average OC Mod is designed to be a parody of common tropes, gimmicks, and cliché's within the FNF modding community.This mod includes:>Four full (?) original songs, featuring vastly different ideas and characters.>A constantly expanding catalogue of a base-game character mix, completely reimagined with new remixes, visuals, and mechanics.>A loosely driven, solely shown in pause menu story spanning every song.>Custom menus, featuring brand new music work and hand-drawn visuals.>30+ Achievements and unlockables>OCs, duh.

mods.title: OURPLE GUY: PARKER PACK
mods.description: DISCLAIMER: This mod is intended for those who have played, or are familiar with, Vs. OURPLE GUY. We highly recommend you give it a shot before playing OURPLE GUY: PARKER PACK.As the story goes, a pair of lovers, Brooke and Grace, began to spend time in an old childhood establishment of the latter. In the process, they end up stumbling onto a plethora of unique and expansive worlds contained inside of arcade machines. A series of strange and unexplainable events follows, leading both of them to reopen many old wounds as they struggle to cope with new ones.Now, what if I told you there was another version of this story? What if there was a much cooler, dangerous, handsome man that came before them? What if this man's one goal was to completely and utterly kick the crap out of anything and everything in his path, putting a complete stop to the horrors our original protagtonists would've been subjected to otherwise?Well, I would be lying, because this story, and this man, does not exist.Anyways, here's what it would look like if Parker was the protagonist of Vs. OURPLE GUY. Probably.

mods.title: Codename Lullaby v1.0

See ya.Sorry for my english lol.Installation details:In PC 0.2+: If the mod didnt load, just press tab and select "My Lullaby".In mobile: - Download and install Codename Engine Mobile- Place the unzipped folder in the mods folder of Codename Engine- Start the game and select the mod.

mods.title: VS IMPOSTOR: LEGACY
mods.description: VS IMPOSTOR IS BACK!A from-the-ground-up remaster of the 2023 mod, VS IMPOSTOR V4! VS IMPOSTOR: LEGACY intends to be faithful to the original experience, while introducing new tweaks and features to make it the definitive version of the mod you know and love!VS IMPOSTOR is a total-conversion mod for Friday Night Funkin', in which you face off against colorful Among Us characters. With over 10 weeks and 57 songs! this mod has plenty of content for you to explore, especially with brand-new awards and cosmetics for you to find and collect! And who knows? maybe there are more secrets to discover...OPTIMIZATIONTHE MOD IS ACTUALLY OPTIMIZED NOW... here's a little comparison of Danger alone... although in the real v4 nothing ever unloaded from your memory so by the time you'd get to danger on a fresh playthrough it'd probably be more like 4gigsLANGUAGEThis time around, the mod's not only in English! We've brought members of the community together and have translated the mod into 28 languages!EXPANDED COSMICUBE!Legacy's Cosmicube has been heavily expanded compared to the original from 2023. With tons of new skins and pets to find, you'll have a lot more to find and discover!AWARDSThere are 28 new awards for you to unlock! Will you get them all?BRAND-NEW DLC!With 5 new songs, and an entirely new Cosmicube, the SECURITY DLC will be made available when Legacy launches on April 25th!To install, just drag and drop the "securitydlc" folder into the content folderStill need help? Follow our video guide!MODDINGWanna make your own cosmicube? Add your own week or songs! Check out the official modding doc!
